skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop and deploy web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, and Node.js.
Design and implement user interfaces and interactive web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Develop server-side logic, define and manage data, and integrate with front-end elements using PHP, MySQL, and Node.js.
Manage and manipulate databases using MySQL and other database systems.
Understand and implement full-stack web development, including both front-end and back-end technologies.
Implement security measures in web applications.
Plan, organize, and manage web development projects from conception to deployment.
Work effectively in teams and independently to develop web applications.
Analyze problems and develop effective solutions in web development contexts.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders throughout the web development process.
